annotations.title: Check your account, credits and free estimates left

description:
Reports who you are to Fermi and what you can spend: whether you are using Fermi without an account or with one, your credit balance or free estimates left today, and what each tier costs. Use this before a paid estimate to check the price or balance, after one to see what is left, or when the user asks about credits, free estimates or pricing.

Returns billing (principal "anonymous" or "account", how you authenticated, credit_balance, anonymous_estimates_remaining_today and anonymous_quota_resets_at), tiers (credit_cost, delivery "sync" or "async" and whether it is available without an account, per tier), price_per_credit_usd, and recent_transactions (the account's last 10 credit movements; null without an account).

Cost: free. Checking never spends credits and never uses up a free estimate.

api_key.description: Your Fermi API key. Omit it to ask about your connector's signed-in account, or about your free allowance without an account.
api_key.title: Api Key

name: check_account_and_credits

billing.description: Who this call was billed to and what is left. Present on every Fermi result.

account_id.description: Account id; null without an account.

account_status.description: "created" if this call created the account, otherwise "matched"; null without an account.

anonymous_estimates_remaining_today.description: Free tier-1 estimates left today without an account; null for an account.

anonymous_quota_resets_at.description: When the free allowance resets (next 00:00 UTC, ISO 8601).

auth_source.description: How you were recognised: "bearer" (signed-in connector or token), "api_key" (the argument) or "anonymous".

charged_to.description: What this call drew on: the free daily allowance, account credits, or "none" (free calls).

credit_balance.description: Credits left on the account; null without an account.

is_unlimited.description: True for an internal account that is never charged.

price_per_credit_usd.description: What one credit costs to buy, in US dollars.

recent_transactions.description: The account's last 10 credit movements (entry_type, amount, request_id, created_at); null without an account.

credit_cost.description: Credits one estimate at this tier costs.

delivery.description: "sync" (answer in the same call) or "async" (collect with get_estimate_result).

supports_anonymous_trial.description: True if usable without an account.

title: Check your account, credits and free estimates left
